paragraphs.text: Gallidi is a port city located on the Onyx Bridge , part of the supercontinent of Jamuraa on the plane of Dominaria .

Gallidi is both a port for those vessels who dare cross the treacherous Jamuraan Sea , as well as a trade hub on the road between eastern and western Jamuraa . The favorable climate with warm, dry air and cooling sea breezes allows the city to grow a surplus of grain, which it sells to ships from Corondor .

In 3335 AR , Adira Strongheart and her Robaran Mercenaries , including Jedit Ojanen and Hazezon Tamar , came to Gallidi on a Corondorian sailing vessel, having navigated the Jamuraan Sea . They disembarked in the city, and from there crossed the Onyx Bridge to the Sea of Serenity 's coast, returning to Bryce through that route.
